_readme:
Reasonix owns this tool and capability vocabulary and the fields of its transcript tool record. LeapMux owns the envelope key around that record. MCP forms use the standard ACP elicitation contract. `noticePrefixes` holds the two prefixes that Reasonix prepends to a message chunk it emits beside the model stream: a warning notice and a compaction note that states how many earlier messages it saved. Sources: internal/frontend/acp/dispatch.go at v2.53.1 (textBlock("

[warning] " + e.Text), textBlock(fmt.Sprintf("

[compacted %d earlier messages to save context]", e.Compaction.Messages))). Limit: the worker matches a chunk whose whole text starts with either prefix, so a model chunk that begins with the same bytes reads as a notice; Reasonix emits these chunks only through its own dispatch, and the model would have to echo the exact prefix for the two to meet. The native tool record also carries images as data URLs. The worker reconstructs those images from the event log and its verified image blobs before the browser reads the record.

Ask.why: the browser presets select Auto and Yolo; Reasonix labels Ask in the native option group, so the browser does not consume the Ask constant
